status: PRE-REGISTERED BEFORE EXECUTION. Immutable and additive. Nothing in this file may be edited after the first execution; a correction must be a new additive addendum.

hypothesis.statement: The B1R2 all-data reconstruction curve attained its best aggregate RMSE at epoch 396 of a 400-epoch budget, i.e. at the boundary. B1R2-A tests ONLY whether the budget was the binding constraint, by extending it to 1200 epochs and changing nothing else.
what_is_NOT_tested_here: no reweighting of the head cycles
no architecture, observation-contract or masking change
no dataset, label, cache or gate change
no FSM v3, morphology, contact, reward or SEA change

parent.role: the ONLY parent; every fold and the final fit start byte-identical from it
parent.forbidden_parents: any B1_*, B1R1_*, S0D_*, S1*, REV4* artefact; July checkpoints
parent.july_status: methodological reference only; no July checkpoint, label or cache is used

student.first_layer_columns: zeroed, frozen, and restored to zero after every optimizer step

validation_design.composition: 6 cycles held out by B1R1, plus 2 structurally complete cycles that begin at the episode origin (nominal 0:163, plus020 0:143), plus 3 genuine tails (minus020 489:499, nominal 468:499, plus020 448:499)
validation_design.structure_derivation: derived from the FSM columns, never hardcoded: a segment is a complete cycle when a full stance then a full swing closes on the next heel-strike; it is a tail when the episode ends inside it
validation_design.coverage: every one of the 1313 non-WAIT rows is held out EXACTLY ONCE
validation_design.wait_policy: the 187 WAIT rows are NEVER held out; they remain reconstruction-only and are explicitly not a generalisation measurement
validation_design.all_rows_binding: all 1500 rows remain binding in the final gates, unchanged

epoch_selection_rule.no_future_reading: e* is a function of the pooled VALIDATION curve alone. The final all-1500 fit and its metrics never enter the selection. The gates are applied only after e* is fixed. No fold is ever evaluated at its own best epoch.
epoch_selection_rule.step_1: Eleven independent fits, all starting byte-identically from B0, one per fold. Each runs the FULL 1200-epoch budget with NO internal early stop, recording val_mse at every epoch 1..1200. fit_masked is reused unchanged.
epoch_selection_rule.step_2: pooled(e) = sum_k n_k * mse_k(e) / sum_k n_k, with n_k the validation rows of fold k and sum_k n_k = 1313.
epoch_selection_rule.step_2_identity: Because the eleven folds partition the non-WAIT rows exactly once, pooled(e) IS the out-of-fold mean squared error over EVERY one of the 1313 non-WAIT rows, each scored by the one fold that held it out. No non-WAIT row is ignored and none is counted twice. sqrt(pooled(e)) is therefore the out-of-fold aggregate RMSE over the whole non-WAIT set.
epoch_selection_rule.step_3: e* = July's rule applied to pooled(): the stale counter resets only on strict improvement greater than 1e-9; e* is the FIRST epoch attaining the pooled minimum; the curve is considered stopped after 60 consecutive stale epochs. The function is v26b_b1r1_exec.pooled_best_epoch, reused unchanged, with patience 60 and eps 1e-9.
epoch_selection_rule.step_4: Every fold is evaluated at the SAME e*, never at its own best.
epoch_selection_rule.step_5: The final fit restarts byte-identically from B0 on ALL 1500 rows for exactly e* epochs, in fixed_final_epoch mode with no validation.
epoch_selection_rule.auditability: Two-pass determinism: re-running a fold for exactly k epochs reproduces bit-for-bit the state the 1200-epoch run held at epoch k. The test asserts it.
epoch_selection_rule.patience_unchanged: patience stays at July's 60. It is part of the pinned protocol, not part of the budget; changing it would be a second variable.

budget_readout.purpose: the actual measurement of the hypothesis, at zero extra compute
budget_readout.method: the July rule is applied twice to the SAME recorded curve: once truncated to the first 400 epochs and once over the full 1200. This is an exact apples-to-apples budget contrast on identical fits and an identical design.
budget_readout.diagnostic_only: e_star_400 is DIAGNOSTIC and can never change e*, the gates or the verdict
budget_readout.budget_was_binding_if: e_star_1200 > e_star_400, or pooled(e_star_1200) < pooled(e_star_400) by more than 1e-9
budget_readout.budget_still_insufficient_if: the pooled curve never exhausts its 60-epoch patience within 1200 epochs. This outcome is to be REPORTED, not fixed: no autonomous extension of the budget is permitted.

gates.source: imported from v26b_b1r1_exec; never restated by hand; not relaxed

binding.requirement: 10 keys, width 35, columns 0:2 and 25:35 exactly zero, no masked update, logstd byte-identical to B0, critic never loaded

binding.definition: sqrt(pooled(e*)), the out-of-fold aggregate RMSE over all 1313 non-WAIT rows

stop_go.GO: promote a candidate ONLY if ALL binding gates pass. Promotion writes candidates/B1R2A_BASE35_BUDGET1200/.
stop_go.NO_GO: if ANY binding gate fails: STOP offline. No candidate is promoted, no rollout, no collection, no DAgger, no B1R2-B. Report exactly which gates, which folds and which regions fail.
stop_go.always: the diagnostic receipt and a NON-DEPLOYABLE state are written under diagnostics/b1r2a/ regardless of the verdict, so the evidence survives a failure
stop_go.no_post_hoc: no threshold, hyperparameter or rule may be changed after seeing any number. A failure is recorded as a failure.
stop_go.single_execution: one execution only; no retry; artefacts are preserved on failure

prohibited_in_this_stage: any promotion without a full gate pass
